cards.answer: Zoe is an AP mage who threatens sleep into heavy magic damage with a redirected star. Her star deals more damage with distance travelled.
cards.counterplay: Dodge her bubble, avoid lingering traps, and watch for the redirected star.

cards.answer: Zoe fires a star and can redirect it, increasing its speed and size. It explodes on hitting an enemy, dealing magic damage nearby; the redirected flight gains damage with distance travelled.
cards.counterplay: Track the redirection and avoid standing close to allies in its path.

cards.answer: Zoe can collect shards from enemy summoner spells, eligible item actives, and certain minions to reuse the stored effect. Casting Spell Thief or a summoner spell grants movement speed and bolts that deal magic damage to nearby enemies.
cards.counterplay: Account for the spell she collects and give her space when she gains speed and bolts.

cards.answer: Zoe fires a bubble that hits an enemy or lingers as a contact trap if it misses. Passing through terrain extends its range. It deals magic damage and applies a growing slow before sleep prevents actions and reduces magic resistance. A qualifying damage hit wakes the target and adds capped bonus true damage.
cards.counterplay: Watch wall angles, avoid the lingering trap, and cleanse drowsiness before sleep when possible.

citations.quote: Active: Zoe kicks a bubble in the target direction that bursts upon the first enemy hit. At max range, it will linger as a trap for a few seconds that bursts upon enemy contact.

facts.claim: Zoe fires a bubble that hits an enemy or lingers as a contact trap if it misses.

citations.quote: The next instance of non- persistent damage from champions, large monsters or turrets against the target, within 3.25 seconds of the sleep being applied, ends the sleep prematurely if it is active and deals bonus true damage equal to the post-mitigation damage dealt, capped at Sleepy Trouble Bubble's damage.

facts.claim: A qualifying damage hit wakes the target and adds capped bonus true damage.

cards.answer: Zoe briefly blinks to a nearby location, then returns to her starting position. At the destination she cannot move normally, but can attack and cast spells.
cards.counterplay: Anticipate spells from her destination and aim pressure at her return position.
